bluf: Tinuiti is a New York based, private equity owned (New Mountain Capital) independent media agency of 1,000+ employee owners that sells commerce, streaming TV, social and search as one full funnel, measured through its patented Bliss Point operating system, with about $4.5B in media under management by its own claim. The record shows a company adding enterprise agency of record wins through 2026 (Wolverine Worldwide, Allies of Skin, SNIPES USA), shipping measurement products first to market, and building an AI SEO line beside them. The one thing a rival should know: it sells AI visibility with no llms.txt and paid social with no social pixel on its own site, so half of its tested house contradicts the pitch.
doing:
Tinuiti calls itself the largest independent full funnel marketing agency, with about $4.5B in media under management, under the line "Love Growth. Hate Waste." In plain words: a performance media buyer that joins Amazon and commerce media, streaming and linear TV, paid social and paid search under one measurement layer and sells the measurement as the reason to consolidate. The sold mix leads with Data & Measurement and Retail Media, both scored 3. The measurement line is the patented Bliss Point Marketing Operating System with Incrementality Lab, Holistic ROAS, Rapid Media Mix Modeling and Geo MMM, a YouTube Intelligence Suite and, since 2026-09, a Meta Creative Health Dashboard the record describes as first to market with Meta's creative fatigue signals. Commerce is the first service line, backed by Amazon Ads Advanced Partner status and cases for Ursa Major, Honest and Poppi.

Behind the leads, four lines score 2: AI Search / GEO (an AI SEO offering launched in 2025 that leads the Search page, ten AI search URLs including AEO guides), Paid Search (born as a search agency, Google Premier Partner top 3%, the Murad case), Paid Social (Meta and TikTok lines, Meta Business Partner, the OLLY Reels case a 2026 Meta Agency Award finalist) and Programmatic & CTV (TV, Audio & Display covering streaming, linear, audio and OOH, the Chomps Thursday Night Football case). The service list also carries Shoppable Media, Affiliate, Performance Creative, CRO, Email & SMS and Influencer. Partners on record: Google Premier Partner, Amazon Ads Advanced Partner, Meta Business Partner, Google Meridian certified partner, Microsoft Advertising and Guideline (an August 2026 partnership). AdCopy AI is the creative tool; Foundation is a separate offer for midsize brands.

The AI posture is AI SEO for visibility in AI answers, AdCopy AI creative tooling, and AI assisted planning and creative signals inside Bliss Point. Pricing is qualified rather than published: the contact form sorts prospects by annual budget bands from under $1M to $50M+. The dated moves run from the 2021 purchases of Bliss Point Media and Ortega Group with New Mountain Capital's investment, the 2023 Ampush acquisition, the 2025 platform and AI SEO launch, a 2026 leadership change (Abbey Klaassen as CEO, Bryan Wiener as board chairman), the July 2026 agency of record wins for Wolverine Worldwide and Allies of Skin, and the September 2026 trio: the SNIPES USA win, Wes Harris as Global Chief Operating Officer, and the Meta Creative Health Dashboard. Conspicuously absent for a media agency of this size: any local or LSA line beyond a score of 1, any AI automation or agent line, and an owned llms.txt.
clients:
Home market: the United States (a New York City office); a September 2026 release adds 1,200 staff across US, Mexico and EMEA. The record classes the book as mixed across beauty, apparel and footwear, food and beverage, health and wellness, B2B, home services, financial services and home furnishings.

The needs read names 20 clients, 13 observed and 7 names only; commerce and marketplaces lead the mix. The Honest Company, Ursa Major and Sony carry Amazon slugs; OLLY, whose Reels case lowered CPMs by 12%, codes commerce and social. Wolverine Worldwide came to unify brand and performance marketing across North American brands, Chomps for a Thursday Night Football ad that paid off in sales, Boston Proper for creative paid social, Liquid I.V. for social, TV and audio, Hourglass Cosmetics for an AI search strategy behind $1M in global expansion, eos for Geo MMM (coded data and AI), Leafguard for media matched to its branch network and Brooks Running for email. Murad's search case codes organic, though the Paid Search note cites it.

The 7 names only are SNIPES USA, Serta Simmons Bedding and Allies of Skin on agency of record releases, and Blue Apron, NOBULL, e.l.f. Beauty and TIAA, whose slugs name TV or streaming with no coded need. The SNIPES USA excerpt describes integrated paid media the needs read leaves uncoded.

Three sit on other tracked books: The Honest Company (big-leap), e.l.f. Beauty (movers-shakers) and Brooks Running (assembly).

With KJ9 a tailwind at 0.208 and KJ5 the headwind at -0.129, it is likely these brands keep buying incrementality and MMM, as eos and Leafguard did. Hourglass Cosmetics is the one AI search case; it is a roughly even chance, with low confidence, that more beauty clients ask for AI visibility next, which the house sells without an llms.txt.
house: Two of four tested lines are practised on its own house; the integrity score is 50. Corroborated: it runs its own Google ads (11 in the Transparency Center, 2 in the last 30 days, all text, last shown 2026-09-27) and 24+ LinkedIn ads, all company page, one of which reads "The instinct with creative diversification is to produce more. The real unlock is producing differently. For OLLY Body,". Contradicted: it sells AI visibility and publishes no llms.txt, with 10 AI-topic URLs in its sitemap; it sells paid social and runs no social ad pixel on its own site. Both are the Radar's gap flags. The tag stack is GTM, VWO and Cookiebot on WordPress, so consent and testing are in place. The sitemap lists 3911 URLs with 49 updated in 90 days and 708 in 365, a slower cadence than its size suggests. No AI crawlers are blocked. Its own channels link LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X and Facebook.
market:
The Horus read is Favored at +19.2, the 70th percentile, with the sold mix at 16:34 on the Solar Arc (dusk). It is best placed for KJ1 (the click is being replaced by the citation) through AI Search / GEO and paid search, and for KJ9 (measurement gets worse before it gets better) through Data & Measurement. It is most exposed to KJ5 (the price of attention splits in two) through paid social and programmatic and CTV. Best scenario fit is The Walled Oasis at 45; resilience 35.9. On the eight moves it is making one, supplying the inputs automation runs on (P4); partial on an audited AI visibility product (P1), feeds and entities (P2) and owned audiences (P7); absent on LSAs (P3), retraining juniors into agent operators (P6) and testing ads inside assistants (P8); pricing on outcomes (P5) is unknown to the record.

The Monsoon read is Onshore wind at 55.5, the 46th percentile: 43 of it is the sold mix, with measurement and paid search carrying the most movable hours, and automation overlaps 21% of those hours. Migration 56.5 against displacement 54.5, with private equity ownership, scale (1,000+ people) and a scaled performance model as the terms. The shore split points 65% to South and Southeast Asia and 25% to Latin America; the record lists a Mexico presence in the September 2026 boilerplate but no hub office, so the read is observed only through scale.
openings:
The strongest opening is the AI visibility line: Tinuiti sells AI SEO and publishes no llms.txt, has no audited AI visibility product in the record, and its house integrity is 50. A rival with a citation share scorecard and its own llms.txt can, likely, take the AI search conversation with the beauty and consumer brands on this book, because the pitch is measurable and Tinuiti's own record does not measure it yet. The falsifier is an llms.txt on tinuiti.com or an AI visibility scorecard inside Bliss Point at the next compile.

Second, paid social: it sells paid social and runs no social pixel on its own site while its OLLY and Boston Proper cases lean on creative; roughly even chance that a creative led social specialist wins the next Reels brief against it. Third, the three shopping clients (The Honest Company, e.l.f. Beauty, Brooks Running) already buy from other tracked agencies and are contestable by definition. Fourth, the 7 clients named with no described work (SNIPES USA, Serta Simmons Bedding and TIAA among them) are new enough or opaque enough that a rival can ask what the measurement actually delivered. The hardest ground to take is measurement itself: incrementality, MMM and the Meta creative dashboard are where the record shows depth, and it is very unlikely a smaller rival beats it there on product.
watch: Alphabet's Q3 2026 search growth and AI Mode ad disclosures, late October 2026: the AI SEO line Tinuiti launched in 2025 gains or loses ground with it.
Reddit US daily users against search referral volatility, late October 2026: the UGC starvation risk under KJ1.
OpenAI ad run-rate and CPM trend, rolling: a $2B milestone or pricing below $20 CPM tells whether ads inside assistants become a Tinuiti line (it is absent on P8 today).
The Meta Creative Health Dashboard launched 2026-09: whether a client case quotes it by the next compile.
The next Radar compile: an llms.txt, a social pixel, or a hub office would change three lines of this read.
